title: QSAR screening identifies antimalarial sesquiterpene lactones
summary: QSAR virtual screening of a natural-product database prioritized compounds for in-vitro testing against chloroquine-sensitive and multidrug-resistant P. falciparum. The paper reports two sesquiterpene lactones, LDT-597 and LDT-598, with potent and selective activity. ADME/PBPK predictions are not measured pharmacokinetics, and the assays do not establish clinical efficacy.
ai_technology: QSAR activity models; QSPR ADME and PBPK predictors
organization: University of Campinas; Federal University of Goiás

evidence.tested: Primary article reports experimental validation of two prioritized compounds against parasite strains and human hepatoma cells.
evidence.unknown: Compound-level prior art and animal efficacy remain open; predicted PK is computational, not measured.
evidence.ai_role: QSAR screen prioritizes commercial natural products/derivatives for parasite and cytotoxicity assays.

source_review.scope: publisher primary full text. Material checked for the specific claims stated in the record.
